title: Seacrest Beach "The Story House" 29 Vinings Lane
h1: Seacrest Beach "The Story House" 29 Vinings Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Heated (Winter) Community Pool only steps away- Parking for 2 cars in driveway- Charcoal Grill- 3 Adult bikes- Private screened porch- Close Proximity to the beach- 18 Mile Bike Path along 30A- Close to The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Seaside- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to The Story House, where legendary vacations come to life! This 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom Seacrest Beach home sleeps up to 9 guests and welcomes 2 dogs, making it perfect for families or groups visiting 30A. Indulge in days of leisurely swims, seashell hunts, and playing in the waves—beach access is only a 3-minute walk, and a seasonally heated community pool is steps away! With a private screened-in porch and charcoal grill, it’s easy to savor time in the fresh air, and the location is incredibly convenient with The Big Chill and Alys Beach nearby for entertainment, dining, and shopping!Warm wood-style flooring, crisp white walls, and accents of natural rattan and jute create a casual, coastal environment that’s perfect for beach vacations inside this single-story home. The spacious great room provides a continuous flow between the living, dining, and kitchen spaces. Imagine joyful mornings prepping a flavorful breakfast with ease, thanks to the modern appliances and ample counter space, while loved ones sip coffee at the sprawling breakfast bar that seats 4. When it’s time to eat, gather together at the beachy 6-person dining table a few feet away. The living space features a plush couch and 3 accent chairs arranged around a TV and coffee table for unwinding, or guests can wander onto the colorful screened-in porch, with 2 swings, a patio table for 4, and views of the flourishing greenery. A laundry room, grill, and outdoor shower provide the finishing touches for a convenient beach getaway. At bedtime, discover a restful haven in the primary and guest bedroom, each boasting a soft queen bed and private bathroom. Those young in age or spirit will love the bunk room's twin-over-twin-over-twin bunk bed and porch access. For additional sleeping accommodations, a queen sleeper sofa is in the living area.Boasting quick beach access and plenty of amenities, The Story House has everything guests need for a memorable Seacrest Beach getaway—plus parking for 2 cars in the driveway and 3 complimentary adult bikes for cruising the Timpoochee Trail. To reach the nearest beach access, follow Vinings Lane, turn left onto Patina Boulevard, continue to thecrosswalk at East County Highway 30A, and the boardwalk is on the other side of the road. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 9):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living Room*This home is pet-friendly for up to 2 dogs with an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $200, plus tax.*This home's official address on Google is in Inlet Beach, but is advertised in Seacrest Beach due to the proximity to amenities.
